items.title_zh: 好消息落地：两则正面消息推动英伟达股价大涨
items.summary: Nvidia shares moved sharply: during the US overnight session in the afternoon of November 10 Beijing time, the stock jumped and was up more than 2% intraday.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达股价剧烈波动：北京时间 11 月 10 日下午的美股夜盘时段，该股跳涨，盘中涨幅超过 2%。

items.title: After 51 months, Tesla's China monthly sales fall below 10,000 units again
items.title_zh: 时隔 51 个月，特斯拉中国月销量再度跌破 1 万辆
items.summary: 8,817 units: that was Tesla's China sales volume in October.
items.summary_zh: 8817 辆，这是特斯拉今年 10 月的国内销量。

items.title: Anthropic and Nvidia launch on the same day: are robots finally getting brains?
items.title_zh: Anthropic 与英伟达同日发布：机器人终于要长脑子了？
items.summary: On November 9 local time, Nvidia and Anthropic released new products back to back, adding fresh fuel to the robotics theme.
items.summary_zh: 当地时间 11 月 9 日，英伟达与 Anthropic 接连发布新品，为机器人主题再添燃料。

items.title: Huang and Nvidia hit by a shareholder class action; the investigation has erased about 193 billion dollars of market value
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋与英伟达遭股东集体诉讼，调查已抹去约 1930 亿美元市值
items.summary: The Huang affair keeps escalating: on November 8, according to CCTV Finance, the Nvidia board announced an independent investigation into allegations concerning the CEO's personal associations.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋绯闻持续发酵：11 月 8 日，据央视财经报道，英伟达董事会宣布就 CEO 个人交往相关指控展开独立调查。

items.title: Aggressive Fed rate hikes are quickly becoming the biggest risk to stocks in 2027, says economist
items.title_zh: 经济学家：激进加息正迅速成为 2027 年股市最大的风险
items.summary: The Fed remains too optimistic on its ability to tame inflation, and markets may be too complacent, economist Neil Dutta warns.
items.summary_zh: 经济学家 Neil Dutta 警告，美联储对自身压制通胀的能力仍过于乐观，市场可能也过于自满。
